research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Nautilus Biotechnology is developing systems and methods for computational decoding of biological, chemical, and physical entities and integrated on-chip single-molecule detection to analyze single analytes. Using systems and methods for biomolecule retention and biomolecule preparation, analyte detection systems, particle-based isolation of proteins, and systems and methods for surface structuring, they enable highly multiplexable analysis of proteins and proteomes and detailed characterization and localization of protein modifications.

overview_description.description: Nautilus Biotechnology develops a proteome analysis platform that uses single-molecule measurement and a method called Iterative Mapping to generate detailed digital counts of proteins and proteoforms in biological samples. The company offers an integrated system of instruments, reagents, and software designed for broad proteome coverage and reproducible quantitative data to support research use cases such as drug development, biomarker discovery, and exploratory biological studies. Nautilus creates reagent kits and fluidics systems that work with its optical imaging and analytical tools to process labeled probes and decode complex protein information. Its platform aims to support researchers in uncovering insights into protein behavior and disease mechanisms that are difficult to access with traditional proteomics approaches.

about_short_description.short_description: Nautilus Biotechnology is a life sciences company that develops a platform for analyzing and quantifying the human proteome.

product.name: Nautilus Voyager™ Platform
product.description: An integrated proteomics system combining reagents, fluidics, imaging, ultra-dense nanoarray flow cells, and cloud-based analysis for single-molecule protein and proteoform quantification.

product.name: Iterative Mapping
product.description: A single-molecule proteomics method that repeatedly probes intact proteins on dense arrays, uses machine learning to identify them, and quantifies proteins and proteoforms by counting molecules.

product.name: Nautilus Proteomics Analysis Services
product.description: A research-use-only service that analyzes customer samples using Nautilus single-molecule proteomics workflows and provides protein or proteoform identification and quantification data.

identifier.value: Nautilus Iterative Mapping Early Access Program

product.name: Nautilus Iterative Mapping Early Access Program
product.description: A limited-access program that enables researchers to apply Nautilus’ single-molecule proteomics method and Voyager Platform to research samples before broad availability.

product.name: Voyager instrument
product.description: An instrument for targeted single-molecule protein analysis using iterative affinity probing.
